data.keyword: What's the best payment processor for a small online store?

result.keyword: What's the best payment processor for a small online store?
result.markdown:
For a small online store in the UK, **I'd recommend Stripe as the best all-round payment processor**, with Shopify Payments and PayPal as strong alternatives depending on how your store operates.

The best choice depends on three things\:

- Transaction fees and monthly costs.
- How easily it integrates with your website.
- How well it handles refunds, subscriptions, international payments and fraud protection.

Here's how I'd compare the main options.

## Best payment processors compared

UK market · November 2026 · Indicative standard online UK card fees

| Provider | Typical fee | Best for |
|--------|--------|--------|
| Stripe | 1.5% + 20p | Best overall |
| Square | 1.4% + 25p | Simplicity |
| PayPal | 2.9% + 30p | Customer familiarity |
| Shopify Payments | From 2% + 25p | Shopify stores |
| GoCardless | 1% + 20p | Recurring payments |


Fees are indicative and can vary by card type, plan and transaction. ## My top three recommendations

![Vagus Nerve Certification | MindMax Academy](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/aXMVm1C0IZ2sYL1Cc-pnLa0-TAY84r1ttAkC3L-BonUW-0ZWt4YgfYxZJFNFO507YDw7sEw0_m36oWUAFe9k5k5U7mabcFJnFcYfX_JEQIwvZxSSTzYlrpiE9fNs0cFfLq2VqBOGktLoGahF64GIPKHvKbJJ1Jz0L_56eTNx-TPu4D5oHHq8-DAX5xxs05i8?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Stripe — Best overall**

(My recommendation)

- No monthly processing fee.
- Excellent integrations with WooCommerce and other platforms.
- Apple Pay and Google Pay support.
- Subscriptions, refunds and fraud protection.
- Good international payment capabilities.

Website: [Stripe UK](https://stripe.com/gb)

---

![JRB Studio Bar | salon de coiffure | Centre commercial Arcades, Boulevard du Mont d'Est, Noisy-le-Grand, France](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/bm02BasbqUgog_ZAF3zciMPAVnNZNu1D6wHWsniKZTA7AbfS20zM0jiA3-CajTDsb_g4WwJmnD0tD2-ieNBrzOvZawjPVdwk6jcxkKMjkKHUeVlN53yQ2mu_TH5-CPLFAKrsEn0tFm2g7nAcHGjrnjyWmqMklhJ6qsFYTTQNliP1Ha18CFpEg48fICmz8a7w?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. PayPal — Best additional checkout option**

- Familiar to many online shoppers.
- Customers can pay using PayPal or eligible cards.
- Easy to add to most online stores.
- Useful for giving customers another way to pay.

Website: [PayPal Business](https://www.paypal.com/uk/business)

---

![square-logo](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/1usVU99QTc623Z1qK0LnerrVUCFuaCZRY9kzKFoWI_Gdr9NcpX1vWKOmILymiErxn6ndDcZZ0Or5-PjPVYj_lTK1K9NB9Q8Cck3TogeQjE13w7S0OC_soTbxUb84o9oqvCcpbffi8RgWQf3ncfxvUqtopiXbgd9lTiIMfcExXBRU8XgKgcPu-V2QhGDsZYzn?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Square — Best for simplicity**

- Straightforward setup.
- Online payment links and checkout.
- Connects online and physical sales.
- Free entry-level tools.

Website: [Square UK](https://squareup.com/gb/en)

## What I'd choose

For a typical small online shop\:

- Use Stripe as your primary card processor.
- Offer PayPal as an additional payment method.
- Add Apple Pay and Google Pay where supported.

This gives customers flexibility without making your payment setup unnecessarily complicated.

One important exception: if you're using Shopify, I'd generally choose Shopify Payments rather than Stripe directly, because Shopify can charge additional transaction fees when you use an external processor.
